|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Sonic Bombardment (V) (Virtual Block 8)]] (version 2 of 4). The image here is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-p3-17-Sonic_Bombardment-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]; no published image shows this text). The current text is [[Sonic Bombardment (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' ([[Sonic Bombardment (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"), page 3, slip 17 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Once per game ▲ a prison. OR Use 1 Force to ▲ a non-droid assassin (or slaver) of ability < 5. OR During battle involving an assassin, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to modify the power of a starfighter piloted by your alien.” The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) wrote the ▲ out (“may take into hand … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”), changed “(or slaver)” to “or slaver”, “opponent's battle destiny draws are -1” to “each of opponent's battle destiny draws is -1” and “starfighter” to “starship”<ref name="cl-1281_17-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Once per game, may take into hand a prison from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Use 1 Force to take into hand a non-droid assassin or slaver of ability < 5 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle involving an assassin, each of opponent's battle destiny draws is -1. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to modify the power of a starship piloted by your alien.” The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Sonic Bombardment (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 39)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=39, page 39. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=39 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Once per game ▲ a prison. OR Use 1 Force to ▲ a non-droid assassin (or slaver) of ability < 5. OR During battle involving an assassin, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to modify the power of a starfighter piloted by your alien.” '''What changed:''' The release-sheet words return: “Once per game ▲ a prison. OR Use 1 Force to ▲ a non-droid assassin (or slaver) of ability < 5. OR During battle involving an assassin, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to modify the power of a starfighter piloted by your alien.” for the card list's written-out wording, “each of opponent's battle destiny draws is -1” and “starship”. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip is the lower part of the card, as on the release sheet; like the slip, it prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Sonic Bombardment (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-sonicbombardment-pre.gif]]) prints: “Once per game, ▲ a prison. OR Use 1 Force to ▲ a non-droid assassin (or slaver) of ability < 5. OR During battle involving an assassin, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to modify the power of a starfighter piloted by your alien.” '''What changed:''' A comma is added after “Once per game” (“Once per game, ▲ a prison”); the rest is the Master List wording. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual8-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 7 May 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual8-Dark">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual8-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 7 May 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the Master List (27 April 2013), so it is the latest publication and the current text. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture; like the slip, it prints no slip number. GEMP's current card shows these words and plays as the Master List text (the play change from the card-list text approved by Bill, 11 November 2026, stands).
